name: Create custom entry
description: Create custom entry Creates a DLP custom entry. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries
Creates a DLP custom entry.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — A new entry to create.

name: Create integration entry
description: Create integration entry Integration entries can't be created, this will update an existing integration entry. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries/integration
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries/integration
Integration entries can't be created, this will update an existing integration entry. This is needed for our generated terraform API.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — This endpoint will update an existing integration entry. It is not possible to create new integration entries.

name: Create predefined entry
description: Create predefined entry Predefined entries can't be created, this will update an existing predefined entry. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries/predefined
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries/predefined
Predefined entries can't be created, this will update an existing predefined entry. This is needed for our generated terraform API.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — This endpoint will update an existing predefined entry. It is not possible to create new predefined entries.

name: Delete custom entry
description: Delete custom entry Deletes a DLP custom entry. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries/{entry_id}

name: Delete integration entry
description: Delete integration entry This is a no-op as integration entires can't be deleted but is needed for our generated terraform API. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries/integration/{entry_id}

name: Delete predefined entry
description: Delete predefined entry This is a no-op as predefined entires can't be deleted but is needed for our generated terraform API. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries/predefined/{entry_id}

name: Get DLP Entry
description: Get DLP Entry Fetches a DLP entry by ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries/{entry_id}

name: List all entries
description: List all entries Lists all DLP entries in an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/entries
Lists all DLP entries in an account.
Required: account_id (path)
